    CkretGuard by Orenthic

    Local scanning. No server. No prompt history.

    On supported chat pages, detected credentials pause sending with Send, Edit, and Mask choices. Mask replaces detected values with xxxxx and sends the masked prompt. Websites can see text typed into their pages. Files, images, voice, and other apps are outside this version’s coverage. No detector finds every secret.
